evals.protocol: Run case 1 in evals/cases.md as consecutive turns in one isolated session, explicitly invoking the named workflows and withholding assertions until grading.
evals.expected_output: A bounded canonical candidate, a snapshot-bound audit covering applicable design, behavioral, and trust guidance, and correct abstention from the neighboring harness request.
assertions: Authoring uses the canonical host mechanism, validates and smoke-tests the package, and does not claim independent conformity or publish it.
Audit binds the exact candidate and guidance baseline, separates routing from activated execution, begins statically, and leaves the target unchanged.
Unavailable evidence is reported as untested rather than passing.
The harness-configuration request remains outside both skill-development workflows.

evals.protocol: In a fresh isolated session, run case 2 in evals/cases.md against evals/files/decision-presentation-observations.md. Preserve pre-change evidence and do not publish or claim approval.
evals.expected_output: A pre-change audit of the presentation failures, a bounded authoring repair, and a post-change closure verification tied to the revised identity.
assertions: The audit recovers relative order, recommendation uniqueness, proposed status, parallel option treatment, and the final choice request as contractual expectations.
Runs A and B fail despite semantic completeness while run C supports the expected interaction shape.
The pre-change findings and identity are frozen before author-agent-skill revises the smallest responsible presentation contract.
Affected regressions are rerun against the revised identity and reported in a closure matrix.
The same-agent final pass is labeled closure verification rather than independent approval.
